scenarios.notes: Example-only airflow review: 0.3 ACH is modeled uncontrolled infiltration, separate from one controlled outdoor-air stream with 0.3 ACH minimum and 40 ACH installed maximum. Fan specific power 180 W/(m3/s) is an illustrative screening input, not a selected fan rating. This generic greenhouse envelope and its airflow bounds are screening assumptions, not a construction-specific literature range or measured leakage. Heat recovery is not installed. Installed cost is an unchanged screening allowance, not a quote; equipment and airflow changes are not priced automatically. Review here authorizes running the example only and is not project approval.
